changelog: Spoken punctuation gains currency symbols: say "taka sign" / "rupee sign" / "euro sign" / "pound sign" (or "টাকা চিহ্ন" / "রুপি চিহ্ন" / "ইউরো চিহ্ন" / "পাউন্ড চিহ্ন") while dictating in WhatsApp/Messenger and a price writes itself ("price taka sign 500" -> "price ৳500") — v13.0 covered $ alone, the other four currencies a Bangladeshi seller dictates were missing.
